summary_en: Update on management initiatives to realize cost-of-capital and stock-price-conscious operations. Current analysis and assessment conducted; improvement roadmap disclosed in attached materials.
title_en: Update on Initiatives to Realize Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: Kanto Denka Kogyo filed an update on 29 June 2026 regarding its ongoing management initiatives to realize operations conscious of cost of capital and stock price. The filing announces that the company has conducted current-state analysis and evaluation of its improvement efforts, with details deferred to attached materials. The disclosure represents a periodic progress update to investors on the company's capital-efficiency and shareholder-value agenda, without disclosing specific new targets, metrics, or program parameters in the announcement itself.
